channel.title: The MacEx Journal
channel.description: Practical ideas for a calmer Mac.

item.title: Show Folder Sizes in Finder on Mac
item.description: Finder can show folder sizes in List view, but the setting is easy to miss. Turn it on, understand the delay, and inspect large folders safely.

item.title: Is Your iCloud Drive File Actually on Your Mac?
item.description: A file can appear in Finder without being stored locally. Check iCloud Drive status and use Download Now, Keep Downloaded and Remove Download safely first.

item.title: Why Downloads Don’t Show in Finder Recents on Mac
item.description: Downloaded a file but can’t see it in Finder Recents? Learn what Recents shows, how to sort Downloads by Date Added, and save a recent-files view on Mac.

item.title: Find Text Inside Images and PDFs on Mac
item.description: Find words in Mac screenshots and scanned PDFs. Learn what Preview and Spotlight can do, when a scan needs OCR, and how to search across your file library.

item.title: System Data vs Purgeable Space on Mac
item.description: System Data and purgeable space are not the same. Learn why Storage and Disk Utility show different Mac space totals, and what to do safely on your Mac.

item.title: Where Mac screenshots are saved, and how to stop the pile-up
item.description: Mac screenshots land on the Desktop by default. Change the save location in two clicks, then clean up the ones you already have without losing anything.

item.title: Spotlight not finding files on Mac: what to check first
item.description: A file you know exists is missing from Spotlight. Check the folder, Search Privacy and result settings, then rebuild the index, in that order.

item.title: How to Find Large Files on Your Mac
item.description: Running out of Mac storage? Find your biggest files with Storage settings and Finder, then remove what you no longer need without deleting the wrong thing.

item.title: Can you delete DMG files on a Mac? When it is safe
item.description: A DMG is only the container an app came in. Once the app is in Applications you can usually delete it. Here is how to check, and when to keep one.

item.title: A Mac file naming system you can actually keep using
item.description: Make project files easier to recognize with a simple subject, date and version pattern, with examples for invoices, drafts, screenshots and shared work.

item.title: Finder Smart Folders: a project view without moving files
item.description: Build a saved Finder search for active work, understand what Smart Folders actually store, and choose rules that stay useful as your projects grow.

item.title: How to find a file on your Mac when you forgot its name
item.description: Turn the clues you remember into a useful search: file type, approximate date, likely location, and content. A practical workflow for Finder and MacEx.
